diagrams.title: The Awareness Program Loop
diagrams.subtitle: Analyze, train, target, remediate, measure — then repeat with new data.

quiz.question: Which step is triggered by an observed individual mistake?

nodes.label: Risk analysis
nodes.detail: Identify audiences, risky behaviors, and topics to cover: phishing, BEC, remote work, OPSEC.
nodes.exam: The program starts from risks and roles, not from a course catalog.

nodes.label: Initial training
nodes.detail: New hire onboarding: policy, AUP, access, and baseline rules before starting the role.

nodes.label: Ongoing training
nodes.detail: Periodic modules for all staff via LMS, self-service portals, or one-to-many delivery.
nodes.exam: Trigger = calendar schedule. LMS is a §5.6 concept absent from the books.

nodes.label: Targeted training
nodes.detail: BEC for accounting, MFA for administrators, remote work for distributed teams.

nodes.label: Corrective training
nodes.detail: Individual follow-up after clicking a simulated phishing link or misdirecting data.

nodes.label: Measurement & governance
nodes.detail: Participation and pass rates, click and reporting rates, behavioral risk score, and leadership reporting.
nodes.exam: An increase in reporting is a sign of vigilance, not failure.
